newsitem.title: USA: Drypers Corp tenders for 12.5 pct notes.
newsitem.headline: Drypers Corp tenders for 12.5 pct notes.

text.p: Drypers Corp said Tuesday that it will buy all of its outstanding 12.5 percent series B senior notes due November 1, 2002 for $1,082.06 per $1,000 in principal. Drypers said it is also paying an additional $2.50 per each $1,000 principal amount.
The company said the tender offer will expire at 1700 EDT/ 2100 GMT June 23, unless extended.
Drypers manufactures and markets disposable baby diapers and related products under the Drypers and other brand names.
